title: Pairing presets
description: The pairing presets (ADR 0025; #577) in the order a client offers them, my own client preset: what a pairing code minted for another client grants, and what a person may change of it before minting. A client resolves a preset to its scopes and ceiling, with the ceiling picked or the scopes ticked where the preset lets them change, and sends both explicit in access.pairings.create; the environment knows nothing of presets, and refuses a ceiling above the minter's own. A code carries no label: the client that exchanges it names its client session, a program with its own name.
